title: AI literacy
summary: Take measures to ensure that staff and others who operate or use the system on the company's behalf have a sufficient level of AI literacy, taking into account their knowledge, experience and the context of use.
appliesBecause: Applies to every provider and deployer of an AI system in scope, whatever its risk class.

action.title: Run and record AI literacy training for staff who use or operate this system

evidenceExpected: Attendance or completion record per person

title: Stop the prohibited practice
summary: A prohibited AI practice may not be placed on the market, put into service or used. The practice must stop or the system must be redesigned so that it falls outside Art. 5.
appliesBecause: The classification found a practice prohibited by Art. 5.

action.title: Stop or redesign the prohibited use and document the decision

evidenceExpected: Decision record stopping the practice or approving a redesign
Legal memo on why the redesigned system is outside Art. 5

title: Risk management system
summary: Establish, document and maintain a risk management system running through the whole lifecycle: identify and analyse foreseeable risks to health, safety and fundamental rights, estimate them, adopt mitigation measures and test the system.
appliesBecause: The company is the provider of a high-risk system.

action.title: Set up and document the risk management system for this system

evidenceExpected: Test plan and results against defined metrics

title: Data and data governance
summary: Training, validation and testing data must be subject to governance practices: documented design choices and collection, examination for possible biases, and data that is relevant, representative and as free of errors as possible.
appliesBecause: The company is the provider of a high-risk system.

action.title: Document data governance and run a bias examination of training data

title: Technical documentation
summary: Draw up technical documentation before the system is placed on the market or put into service, with at least the elements of Annex IV, and keep it up to date.
appliesBecause: The company is the provider of a high-risk system.

action.title: Draft the Annex IV technical documentation

title: Record-keeping (logging)
summary: The system must technically allow automatic recording of events (logs) over its lifetime, sufficient to identify risks, support post-market monitoring and monitor its operation.
appliesBecause: The company is the provider of a high-risk system.

action.title: Specify and implement automatic event logging

title: Transparency and instructions for use
summary: Design the system so deployers can interpret and use its output, and provide instructions for use covering the provider's identity, the system's characteristics, capabilities and limitations, human oversight measures and expected lifetime.
appliesBecause: The company is the provider of a high-risk system.

action.title: Write the instructions for use for deployers

evidenceExpected: Description of capabilities, limitations and performance metrics

title: Human oversight by design
summary: Design the system so natural persons can effectively oversee it while in use: understand its capacities and limits, detect anomalies, avoid automation bias, interpret output, and override or stop it.
appliesBecause: The company is the provider of a high-risk system.

action.title: Design and document human oversight measures, including a stop function

evidenceExpected: Evidence of override and stop functions

title: Accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
summary: Achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity throughout the lifecycle, declare accuracy metrics in the instructions for use, and protect the system against errors, feedback loops and attacks such as data poisoning.
appliesBecause: The company is the provider of a high-risk system.

action.title: Test and document accuracy, robustness and security of the system

evidenceExpected: Security assessment or penetration test report

title: Quality management system
summary: Put in place a documented quality management system covering compliance strategy, design and development controls, testing, data management, risk management, post-market monitoring, incident reporting and accountability.
appliesBecause: The company is the provider of a high-risk system.

action.title: Establish a quality management system covering this system

title: Conformity assessment
summary: Before placing the system on the market or putting it into service, carry out the applicable conformity assessment procedure (internal control under Annex VI, or with a notified body under Annex VII where required).
appliesBecause: The company is the provider of a high-risk system.

action.title: Carry out the conformity assessment procedure

title: EU declaration of conformity
summary: Draw up a written EU declaration of conformity with the content of Annex V for each system and keep it for 10 years.
appliesBecause: The company is the provider of a high-risk system.

action.title: Draw up and sign the EU declaration of conformity

evidenceExpected: Signed EU declaration of conformity (Annex V content)

title: CE marking
summary: Affix the CE marking visibly, legibly and indelibly to the system, or digitally for systems provided digitally, or to its packaging or documentation.
appliesBecause: The company is the provider of a high-risk system.

action.title: Affix the CE marking

evidenceExpected: Screenshot or photo of the CE marking

title: Registration in the EU database
summary: Before placing an Annex III high-risk system on the market or putting it into service, register the company and the system in the EU database (Art. 71).
appliesBecause: The company is the provider of a high-risk system listed in Annex III.

action.title: Register the system in the EU database

title: Post-market monitoring
summary: Establish and document a post-market monitoring system that collects and analyses data on the system's performance throughout its lifetime, based on a post-market monitoring plan.
appliesBecause: The company is the provider of a high-risk system.

action.title: Write the post-market monitoring plan and set up data collection

title: Serious incident reporting
summary: Report any serious incident to the market surveillance authority of the Member State where it occurred, immediately after establishing a causal link and no later than 15 days after becoming aware of it (shorter deadlines for widespread infringements and deaths).
appliesBecause: The company is the provider of a high-risk system.

action.title: Adopt a serious-incident procedure

title: Document the not-high-risk assessment and register
summary: A provider who considers that an Annex III system is not high-risk under Art. 6(3) must document that assessment before placing it on the market or putting it into service, provide it to authorities on request, and register the system in the EU database.
appliesBecause: The company is the provider and relies on the Art. 6(3) derogation for an Annex III use case.

action.title: Document the Art. 6(3) assessment and register the system

title: Use in line with the instructions for use
summary: Take appropriate technical and organisational measures to use the system in accordance with the instructions for use that accompany it.
appliesBecause: The company is a deployer of a high-risk system.

action.title: Obtain the instructions for use and adopt measures to follow them

evidenceExpected: Internal procedure for using the system

title: Assign human oversight
summary: Assign human oversight to people who have the necessary competence, training and authority, and give them the support they need.
appliesBecause: The company is a deployer of a high-risk system.

action.title: Name and train the people responsible for human oversight

evidenceExpected: Training record of the assigned people

title: Relevant input data
summary: To the extent the company controls the input data, ensure it is relevant and sufficiently representative for the system's intended purpose.
appliesBecause: The company is a deployer of a high-risk system.

action.title: Check and document the quality of input data the company controls

title: Monitor operation and inform the provider
summary: Monitor the system's operation on the basis of the instructions for use, inform the provider of risks, suspend use where needed, and report serious incidents.
appliesBecause: The company is a deployer of a high-risk system.

action.title: Set up operational monitoring and an escalation route to the provider

title: Keep the logs
summary: Keep the automatically generated logs under the company's control for a period appropriate to the purpose, of at least six months unless other law provides otherwise.
appliesBecause: The company is a deployer of a high-risk system.

action.title: Configure log retention of at least six months

title: Inform workers and their representatives
summary: Before putting the system into service or using it at the workplace, inform workers' representatives and the affected workers that they will be subject to it.
appliesBecause: The company is a deployer of a high-risk system. This applies when the system is used at the workplace.

action.title: Inform workers and their representatives before use

title: Inform people subject to decisions
summary: Where an Annex III system makes or assists decisions about natural persons, inform them that they are subject to the use of the system.
appliesBecause: The company deploys an Annex III high-risk system that makes or assists decisions about people.

action.title: Add a notice informing affected people about the system

title: Fundamental rights impact assessment
summary: Before first use, assess the impact on fundamental rights: the processes in which the system is used, the period and frequency of use, the people affected, the specific risks of harm, human oversight measures and the measures if risks materialise. Notify the market surveillance authority of the results.
appliesBecause: The company deploys an Annex III high-risk system and is a public body or provides public services, or the system evaluates creditworthiness or prices life or health insurance.

action.title: Carry out and notify the fundamental rights impact assessment

evidenceExpected: Notification to the market surveillance authority

title: Register the use in the EU database
summary: Deployers that are public authorities, or act on their behalf, must register before using an Annex III high-risk system, select the system in the EU database and register its use.
appliesBecause: The company deploys an Annex III high-risk system as, or on behalf of, a public authority.

action.title: Register the use of the system in the EU database

title: Right to explanation
summary: A person subject to a decision based on an Annex III system's output that has legal or similarly significant effects can ask the deployer for a clear and meaningful explanation of the system's role and the main elements of the decision.
appliesBecause: The company deploys an Annex III high-risk system whose output feeds decisions about people.

action.title: Set up a procedure to answer requests for an explanation

title: Importer verification duties
summary: Before placing the system on the market, verify that the conformity assessment was carried out, the technical documentation exists, the system bears the CE marking with the declaration of conformity and instructions, and the provider has appointed an authorised representative. Indicate the importer's name and contact details.
appliesBecause: The company imports a high-risk system into the EU.

action.title: Run and record the importer verification checklist

evidenceExpected: Copy of the declaration of conformity

title: Distributor verification duties
summary: Before making the system available, verify that it bears the CE marking, is accompanied by the declaration of conformity and instructions for use, and that the provider and importer have met their duties. Do not make it available if it may not conform.
appliesBecause: The company distributes a high-risk system.

action.title: Run and record the distributor verification checklist

title: Disclose interaction with an AI system
summary: Design the system so that people interacting with it are informed that they are interacting with an AI system, unless this is obvious from the context.
appliesBecause: The company provides a system intended to interact directly with natural persons.

action.title: Add an AI interaction notice to the system

evidenceExpected: Screenshot of the AI interaction notice

title: Mark synthetic content
summary: Ensure that synthetic audio, image, video or text output is marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated.
appliesBecause: The company provides a system that generates synthetic content.

action.title: Implement machine-readable marking of generated content

title: Inform people exposed to emotion recognition or biometric categorisation
summary: Inform the natural persons exposed to the system of its operation, and process their personal data in line with the GDPR.
appliesBecause: The company deploys an emotion recognition or biometric categorisation system.

action.title: Publish a notice to people exposed to the system

title: Disclose deep fakes
summary: Disclose that image, audio or video content constituting a deep fake has been artificially generated or manipulated (lighter duties apply to evidently artistic, creative or satirical work).
appliesBecause: The company uses the system to generate or manipulate deep-fake content.

action.title: Label deep-fake content as AI-generated

title: Disclose AI-generated text on matters of public interest
summary: Disclose that text published to inform the public on matters of public interest was artificially generated or manipulated, unless it underwent human review or editorial control and someone holds editorial responsibility.
appliesBecause: The company publishes AI-generated text on matters of public interest without human editorial review.

action.title: Label AI-generated public-interest text, or introduce editorial review

evidenceExpected: Labelling policy or editorial review procedure
